tables.label: TABLE 1
tables.caption: Biological characteristics of the Trp-containing antimicrobial peptides (Bi et al., 2013, 2014).
footnotes: The hydrophobicity of the peptide calculated using the hydrophobicity scale (Mant et al., 2009) was the total hydrophobicity (sum of the hydrophobicity indices for all residues) divided by the number of residues. Amphipathicity was determined by calculation of the hydrophobic moment (Eisenberg et al., 1982; Carver and Bleasby, 2003).

tables.label: TABLE 2
tables.caption: Antibacterial activity of peptides and antibiotics against the multiple-drug resistant Staphylococcus epidermidis.

tables.label: TABLE 3
tables.caption: The fractional inhibitory concentration index (FICI) of the peptide/antibiotic combination against the MRSE 1208 strain.
footnotes: Synergy is defined as FICI ≤ 0.5, addition is defined as 0.5 < FICI ≤ 1.0, and indifference is defined as 1.0 < FICI ≤ 2.0 as indifference (Hollander et al., 1998; Yoon et al., 2004). Experiments were per formed in triplicate (n = 6).
